errors.evidence: In the description for УниКредит Булбанк, it is stated that the value drops to around 30.0% in 2017. However, the chart shows the value is approximately 39% in 2017.
In the description for Банка ДСК, it is stated that the value drops to around 30.0% in 2017. However, the chart shows the value is approximately 40% in that year.
The color of the line for ПИБ is described as 'сиво-сиво-сиво' (grey-grey-grey), which is unnatural and unnecessarily repetitive. 'сиво' (grey) would be sufficient.
In the description for ПИБ, it is stated that the value drops to around 30.0% in 2017. However, the chart shows the value is approximately 60% in that year.
The description for ОББ вкл. СИБ states that the markers are circular ('кръгли'), but the legend and the plot clearly show 'x'-shaped markers for this line.
The description for ОББ вкл. СИБ states that the line is dotted ('пунктирана'), but it is a solid line in the plot.
The description for ОББ вкл. СИБ claims a drop to 30.0% in 2017. In fact, 2017 is the year of a second major peak for this line, at approximately 105%. The drop to a low point occurs in 2018.
